;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Palestinian-Israeli conflict
**The Palestinian Authority signs 15 UN/Geneva human rights treaties including the [[Fourth Geneva Convention]]. Israel responds with sanctions. [[2013–14 Israeli–Palestinian peace talks|Peace talks]] continue.  [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-26982166 (BBC News)] [http://uk.reuters.com/article/2014/04/11/uk-palestinian-israel-annexation-idUKBREA391HA20140411 (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]:
**[[Chemical weapons]] are used again in Syria, this time on the town of Kafr Zita, [[Hama]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2014/04/12/syria-rebels-government-confirm-poison-gas-attack (US News)]
*[[2014 pro-Russian protests in Ukraine]]
**Gunmen gain control of a police department in the town of [[Sloviansk]] in the eastern Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/04/12/us-ukraine-crisis-police-idUSBREA3B04O20140412 (Reuters)]
*[[Naxalite–Maoist insurgency]]/[[Indian general election, 2014]]:
**Suspected Maoist rebels kill 13 people in a bombing in the eastern Indian state of [[Chhattisgarh]], during the [[Indian general election, 2014]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/04/12/us-india-election-blasts-idUSBREA3B06A20140412 (Reuters)]
*[[War in North-West Pakistan]]
**Gunmen kidnap 100 men from a tribal gathering in [[North-West Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/04/12/us-pakistan-taliban-kidnapping-idUSBREA3B0GL20140412 (Reuters)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in Nigeria]]
**[[Borno State]] Senator Ahmed Zannah reports that 135 civilians have been killed in attacks in north west [[Nigeria]] since Wednesday. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-27006876 (BBC News)]
*[[Bundy standoff]]
**Amidst controversy, the [[Bureau of Land Management]] accedes to the release of the Bundy family's cattle. [http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2014/04/13/safety-concerns-led-to-nevada-cow-release-federal-land-managers-say/ (Fox)] [https://news.yahoo.com/u-agency-ends-nevada-cattle-roundup-releases-herd-003456278.html (Yahoo! News)]
